description: Golden SQL pairs for sales, order performance, payment transactions, and financial analytics.

sql_pairs.question: What is the total sales revenue and total count of delivered orders?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_delivered_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered';

sql_pairs.question: Show monthly revenue breakdown and order counts for 2025.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(placed_at, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND YEAR(placed_at) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(placed_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY order_month ASC;

sql_pairs.question: What is the total order volume grouped by order status?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount_sum FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

sql_pairs.question: List the top 10 largest orders by grand total with customer name and shipping city.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, ua.city, ua.state_province, o.total_amount, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN user_addresses ua ON o.shipping_address_id = ua.id ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: Show payment methods breakdown with total captured revenue.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_captured_revenue FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_captured_revenue DESC;

sql_pairs.question: What is the total tax collected and shipping fees charged across all completed orders?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(tax_amount) AS total_tax_collected, SUM(shipping_amount) AS total_shipping_revenue, SUM(subtotal_amount) AS total_subtotal FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped');

sql_pairs.question: Show the latest 10 orders placed with customer email and current status.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, u.email, o.status, o.total_amount, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: Find orders containing more than 2 distinct line items.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, COUNT(oi.id) AS item_count, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id, o.order_number, o.total_amount HAVING COUNT(oi.id) > 2 ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: What is the average order discount amount among orders that received discounts?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders_count, ROUND(AVG(discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount, SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discounts_granted FROM orders WHERE discount_amount > 0.00;
